purpose: Initialize total usable fuel and gross mass after the final ACARS fuel report without using later event time as a target.

rules: no probability assigned to stress-only histories
one explicit model family per run
no mixing of incompatible families as sampling error

invariants: fuel and mass are finite, nonnegative, and dimensionally explicit
gross_mass_kg equals zero_fuel_weight_kg plus modeled onboard fuel mass
fuel never increases without an explicit transfer/source term
the official Arc-1 calculation is validation evidence, never a fit target
stress-family outputs carry zero likelihood weight and cannot initialize the estimator
prohibited_calibrations: 00:17:30 exhaustion target derived from the 00:19 event
acceptance_checks: report all five ACARS interval errors so total-error cancellation is visible
independently validate level-cruise burn against legally usable Trent 892B/9M-MRO-relevant performance evidence
bound numerical integration error below 1 kg for the ACARS fixture
provide a defensible engine-accessible fuel split before predicting engine-specific flameout

blockers.evidence: The untuned proxy over-burns the official calculated Arc-1 comparison by 4226.524 kg.
blockers.resolution: Replace or validate the cruise backend using legally usable, independently checkable performance evidence; do not tune to Arc-1.

blockers.evidence: The official ACARS anchor supplies total fuel, not left/right engine-accessible tank/feed state.
blockers.resolution: Supply an independently supported tank/feed allocation and uncertainty model before engine-specific end-of-flight use.
